newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo trades flat vs mark, seen staying calm.
newsitem.headline: Escudo trades flat vs mark, seen staying calm.

text.p: The Portuguese escudo was trading flat against the German mark but some traders said that the currency had the potential to gain a little ground on Thursday after a senior Bundesbank official said a future German rate cut could not be totally excluded.

The escudo was at 100.94/97 against its closing 100.93/96 on Wednesday. But any eventual gains were likely to be only slight, they said. Most traders saw the currency not straying far from 101.00 to the mark.
The traders were referring to remarks by Bundesbank board member Reimut Jochimsen who said that a further German rate cut could not be ruled out although he did not see one.
